title: New volumes use topology.kubernetes.io/zone instead of topology.ebs.csi.aws.com/zone

detection.reason: what depends on the topology label (StorageClass allowedTopologies, scripts, policies) is not collected

quote: The AZ topology key `CreateVolume` returns has changed from `topology.ebs.csi.aws.com/zone` to `topology.kubernetes.io/zone`. Volumes created on `v1.33.0` or any future version will be incompatible with versions before `v1.28.0`. No other customer-facing impact is expected unless you directly depend on the topology label.
remediation: Check anything that selects on topology.ebs.csi.aws.com/zone — StorageClass allowedTopologies, admission policies, tooling that reads PV nodeAffinity — and accept topology.kubernetes.io/zone as well: PVs created from v1.33 carry only the standard key. After this upgrade do not roll the driver back below v1.28.
verifyCommand: kubectl get storageclass -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.provisioner == "ebs.csi.aws.com") | select(.allowedTopologies != null) | "\(.metadata.name): \([.allowedTopologies[].matchLabelExpressions[].key] | join(","))"'  # a StorageClass listing topology.ebs.csi.aws.com/zone depends on the old key
coversNotes: Migrate CreateVolume response topology to standard label topology.kubernetes.io/zone
